name: Survey tile in Pisces
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Pisces, imaged by SPHEREx 22 times in 7 visits over 69 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 44 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 2.9 days starting 2026-07-13, at wavelengths from 0.79 to 4.90 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
